security_boundary.auth_session: trusted context and logs API are behind authenticated Laravel session middleware
security_boundary.active_tenant_resolution: server-provided FrontendContext tenant drives navigation and TenantContext rejects foreign membership
security_boundary.permission_checks: UI fails closed unless diagnostics.view and operations.manage are present; backend independently requires operations.manage
security_boundary.foreign_tenant_rejection: focused HTTP acceptance plants a real beta-only log and proves an authenticated alpha member cannot read the beta route
security_boundary.direct_id_rejection: not applicable: control and endpoint accept no resource identifier
security_boundary.validation: selected navigation sends no user payload; existing log filters remain server-owned
security_boundary.csrf: not applicable: selected operation and logs endpoint are GET/read-only and perform no mutation
security_boundary.server_derived_identity_and_ownership: authenticated user and active tenant membership are resolved server-side and never supplied by the control
security_boundary.secret_non_exposure: no credential material is rendered or serialized; control consumes only server-advertised route/capability metadata
security_boundary.authoritative_persistence_reread: not applicable because there is no persistence mutation or persisted-success claim
security_boundary.idempotency_retry_cancellation: not applicable to read-only navigation; resource-query Retry is separate and repeated navigation has no mutation side effect
security_boundary.truthful_success: the control only navigates; real log data appears only after protected backend success
security_boundary.fail_closed: missing trust, permission, API contract, enabled capability or tenant membership removes or rejects the path instead of synthesizing diagnostics
